module: Node "Get Vehicle Active" (category `repeat_instant`). Reads the active (visible) state of a vehicle with `obj:getActive()`. Input pin: `vehId` (default: player). Outputs: flow `true` (active), flow `false` (inactive), bool `isActive`.
notes: The pin description says "set visibility" (copy-paste from Set Vehicle Active); this node only reads.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Updates the outputs `true`, `false` and `isActive` according to `getActive()`.
